alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a closed door on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left. One by one a plate, a glass, a bite and a frame slide across the floor and vanish behind the door while the figure leans toward them. Then its eyes turn happy and it pulses proudly. In the last second the text changes from: me tidying up before guests arrive, to: don't open it, while the door shakes and the figure's eyes go wide. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
